result.topic_en: A scrap page with a table of lemniscatic sine values for division points of the quadrant (given in degrees), together with scattered numerical calculations, a list of personal names and pen trials.

methods.what: Table of values of the lemniscatic sine at fractions of the quadrant, with the quadrant taken as 90° (e.g. sl(ϖ/4) = √(√2−1) ≈ 0.6435943)
Decimal digits of 2^-49 (≈1.7763568394002505e-15), with a multiple by 3 (≈5.329e-15) and a multiple by 9 (≈1.5987e-14); 142108 matches the leading digits of 2^-46 (≈1.42108e-14)
Addition of a list of compound (multi-unit) quantities
